description_en: Queries the details about a check item that is used for configuration assessment
description_zh: 获取云平台配置检查项详情
name: GetCheckDetail

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to query the IDs of check items
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的ID。
您可调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取该数据
parameters.name: check_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the [ListCloudAssetInstances](~~ListCloudAssetInstances~~) operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在的地域的ID。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetInstances](~~ListCloudAssetInstances~~)接口获取该数据
parameters.name: region_id

AssistInfo.description_en: The help information about the check item

Link.description_en: The link to the help information about the risk item when the Type parameter is set to link
Link.description_zh: 检查项风险的帮助信息类型为link时的链接

Type.description_en:
The type of the help information about the risk item. Valid values:

text
link
Type.description_zh:
检查项风险的帮助信息类型。取值：

text：文本
link：链接

Value.description_en: The content in the help information about the risk item when the Type parameter is set to text
Value.description_zh: 检查项风险的帮助信息类型为text时的文本内容

CustomConfigs.description_en: The custom configuration items of the check item
CustomConfigs.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项列表

DefaultValue.description_en: The default value of the custom configuration item. The value is a string
DefaultValue.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项默认值字符串

Name.description_en: The name of the custom configuration item, which is unique in a check item
Name.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项名称，同检查项唯一

ShowName.description_en: The display name of the custom configuration item for internationalization
ShowName.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项国际化名称

TypeDefine.description_en: The type of the custom configuration item. The value is a JSON string
TypeDefine.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项类型JSON字符串

Value.description_en: The value of the custom configuration item. The value is a string
Value.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项用户配置值字符串

Description.description_en: The description of the check item

Link.description_en: The link to the description of the check item

Type.description_en: The description type of the check item. The value is fixed as text

Value.description_en: The content in the description of the check item
Value.description_zh: 检查项的描述的具体信息
Value.example: The MSE instance does not enable authentication by default. If public network access is enabled at the same time, the data in the configuration center may be dragged and there is a security risk.

RepairSetting.description_en: The fixing parameter configurations of the check item
RepairSetting.description_zh: 检查项修复设置具体信息

FlowStep.description_en: The description of the fixing workflow

ShowText.description_en: The text description of the fixing step
ShowText.description_zh: 修复流程步骤的说明文本
ShowText.example: The first step is to open the calling interface.

Step.description_en: The sequence number of the fixing step

RepairConfigs.description_en: The configurations of the fixing parameters
RepairConfigs.description_zh: 检查项修复支持的入参配置信息

ConsoleParamType.description_en:
Indicates whether the value of the parameter is displayed in the console. Valid values:

0: The historical value and real-time value of the parameter are displayed.
1: Only the real-time value of the parameter is displayed.
2: The value of the parameter is not displayed in the console
ConsoleParamType.description_zh:
参数类型是否在控制台展示：
0：展示回滚以及实时资产的参数值
1：只展示资产的对应参数实时值
2：不在控制台显示

CustomFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether custom configurations of the fixing parameters are supported. Valid values:

true
false
CustomFlag.description_zh:
该修复参数是否支持用户自定义配置：

true：支持
false：不支持

DataTransformType.description_en:
Indicates whether data needs to be encrypted during transmission. Valid values:

0: Data does not need to be encrypted during transmission.
1: Data needs to be encrypted during transmission.
2: Data needs to be encrypted during transmission, and the user must perform secondary confirmation
DataTransformType.description_zh:
数据是否加密：
0：不需要加密
1：需要加密传输 
2：需要加密传输，并且需要用户二次确认

DefaultValue.description_en: The default value of the parameter. The value is a string
DefaultValue.description_zh: 检查项修复配置参数的默认值字符串

EmptyParamSwitch.description_en:
Indicates whether this parameter is specified by the user. Valid values:

0: The default value is used.
1: This parameter is required, and no default value is specified.
2: This parameter can be left empty
EmptyParamSwitch.description_zh:
该参数用户是否需要填写
0：参数有默认值
1：参数无默认值，用户需要填写
2：该参数可以为空

ExclusiveName.description_en: The fixing parameters that are not compatible with this parameter
ExclusiveName.description_zh: 与该参数不兼容的其他修复配置参数的数组

items.description_en: The fixing parameter that is not compatible with this parameter. You cannot configure the two parameters at the same time
items.description_zh: 与该参数不兼容的其他修复配置参数，无法同时配置

FlowId.description_en: The ID of the fixing workflow

Name.description_en: The name of the parameter. The name must be unique within the check item
Name.description_zh: 检查项自定义修复参数名称，同检查项唯一

ShowName.description_en: The display name of the parameter
ShowName.description_zh: 用户修复参数配置的展示名称

TypeDefine.description_en: The type of the parameter. The value is a JSON string
TypeDefine.description_zh: 检查项自定义配置项类型JSON字符串

UsageType.description_en:
The type of the parameter. Valid values:

1: asset parameters that are required during fixing.
2: user-provided parameters that are required during fixing.
3: parameters that are temporarily provided by the user
UsageType.description_zh:
参数的使用类型：
1：修复时需要的资产参数
2：修复时需要用户传输的参数
3：临时用户传入的参数

Value.description_en: The user-configured value of the parameter. The value is a string
Value.description_zh: 用户配置的检查项修复参数字符串值

RepairReset.description_en:
Indicates whether a restart is required after the fixing. Valid values:

true
false
RepairReset.description_zh:
该检查项支持的修复功能修复后是否重启：

true：重启
false： 不需要重启

RepairSupport.description_en:
Indicates whether the check item supports the quick fix feature. Valid values:

true
false
RepairSupport.description_zh:
该检查项支持的是否支持修复功能：

true：是
false：否

RepairSupportType.description_en:
The fixing type that is supported. Valid values:

1: The fixing and rollback are supported.
2: The fixing is supported, but the rollback is not supported.
3: The fixing must be performed on a third-party platform
RepairSupportType.description_zh:
该检查项支持修复的类型：

1： 支持修复并支持回滚操作
2： 修复不支持回滚
3： 跳转到第三方平台操作

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Solution.description_en: The solution to handle the risk item
Solution.description_zh: 检查项风险的解决方案

Link.description_en: The link to the solution to handle the risk item when the Type parameter is set to link
Link.description_zh: 检查项风险的解决方案类型为link时的链接

Type.description_en:
The type of the solution to handle the risk item. Valid values:

text
link
Type.description_zh:
检查项风险的解决方案类型。取值：

text：文本
link：链接

Value.description_en: The content of the solution to handle the risk item when the Type parameter is set to text
Value.description_zh: 检查项风险的解决方案类型为text时的文本内容
Value.example: Enter the MSE product console - registration and configuration center - instance list, click the corresponding instance name to enter the instance details, find the public network whitelist setting option in the basic information, and configure the whitelist according to business needs. It is forbidden to configure 0.0.0.0 or the whitelist as null.
